newsitem.title: UK: Dixons shares up after first half profits.
newsitem.headline: Dixons shares up after first half profits.

text.p: Shares in electronics retailer Dixons Group Plc were indicated higher on Wednesday after the group reported first half profits of 57.5 million stg and said sales growth over the Christmas period was eight percent. The shares were up 4p at 542p by 0805 GMT. Dixons first-half profits rose by 53 percent to 57.5 million stg compared with expectations of between 54-57 million stg. The interim dividend was raised to 2.4p, slightly below the 2.5p consensus estimate. Dixons paid 2.05 payout a year earlier.
Over the important Christmas trading period Dixons said like-for-like sales growth was maintained at eight percent.
Last year the group reported like-for-like sales growth of 11 percent over this eight-week period but analysts were expecting growth to slip slightly this year.
Gross margins however were at similar year on year levels over the Christmas period after increasing slightly in the first half. Analysts had been expecting an improvement.
